title: Price Responses of Rwandan Tungsten Exports under Conflict Minerals Regulation — Replication Spec
hypothesis: Price responsiveness (export demand elasticity) of Rwandan tungsten (HS 261100) varied over time before/after Dodd-Frank Section 1502 and subsequent institutional/market changes.
data_sources: UN Comtrade importer-reported monthly trade for HS 261100 tungsten ores and concentrates — Rwandan tungsten exports (V_jt, Q_jt where available) and world imports to construct world average price
FXTOP monthly exchange rates E_jt = importing-country currency per Rwandan franc
UN Comtrade global monthly imports of HS 261100 to construct P_t^W
sample: Importer-month panel of Rwandan tungsten ores and concentrates HS261100 from UN Comtrade mirror (importer-reported) data merged with exchange rates and world average price. Estimation conducted separately by period with importer fixed effects and SE clustered at importing-country level. Counts printed in Table 1: Period 1 N_obs=52, N_importers=4; Period 2 N_obs=64, N_importers=7; Period 3 N_obs=37, N_importers=4; Period 4 N_obs=49, N_importers=5. Period boundaries based on Dodd-Frank rule adoption Aug 2012/compliance from Jan 2013, SEC enforcement policy change Apr 2017, and destination-composition shift Jun 2019 observed in UN Comtrade. Product: HS261100 only. Filters not stated beyond importer-reported monthly availability and use of observations with export value; quantity missingness handled by Nakano-Nishimura (2025) exchange-rate identification.
method: 1. Define sample period January 2009 to December 2023 divided into four institutional/market periods as printed: Period 1 Jan 2009--Dec 2012 (pre-full-scale implementation, China-centered), Period 2 Jan 2013--Apr 2017 (Dodd-Frank implementation; SEC adopted rule Aug 2012, compliance from calendar year 2013; Apr 2017 included in Period 2), Period 3 May 2017--May 2019 (post-SEC Apr 7 2017 enforcement-policy change), Period 4 Jun 2019--Dec 2023 (shift in destination composition observed ~2019).

2. Construct world average price P_t^W = sum_i V_it / sum_i Q_it where V_it, Q_it are monthly import value/quantity of HS261100 reported by importing country i from world (UN Comtrade). P_t^W is not used to compute elasticity directly; included to capture common world tungsten price fluctuations.

3. Specify demand lnQ_jt = alpha_j + eta*lnP_imp_jt + u_jt; price in importer lnP_imp_jt = lnE_jt + lnP_exp_jt + tau_j where tau_j is time-invariant importer-specific cost; supply-response lnP_exp_jt = delta_j + omega*lnX_jt + lambda*lnP^W_t + v_jt where X_jt = P_imp_jt*Q_jt export value, P^W_t world price, and (delta_j, tau_j) importer-specific intercepts.

4. Derive reduced form eliminating P_exp: lnX_jt = mu_j + beta*lnE_jt + gamma*lnP^W_t + epsilon_jt with importer fixed effect mu_j. Relationship beta = (1+eta)/(1-omega*(1+eta)), so generically eta = beta/(1+beta*omega)-1.

5. Separately estimate inverse-supply coefficient omega via FE using observations with quantity available: lnUV_jt = a_j + omega*lnX_jt + lambda*lnP^W_t + e_jt where UV_jt = X_jt/Q_jt, a_j importer FE, SE clustered at importer level. Result omega_hat=0.04384 (SE 0.02660) 95% CI [-0.00829,0.09597] not significant at 5% level and point estimate small; approximate omega=0. Then eta = beta-1. Details in Appendix.

6. For each period r=1..4 estimate by importer fixed-effects: lnX_jt on lnE_jt and lnP^W_t, with importer FE included in all estimations. Report beta_r with clustered SE, gamma_r with clustered SE, derived eta_r = beta_r -1 and 95% CI, N_obs_r and N_importers_r. Clustering: importing-country level. Significance thresholds: ***p<0.01, **p<0.05, *p<0.10 as printed.

7. Coefficient-difference tests: null H0: beta_r = beta_s. For each pair (2-1, 3-1, 4-1, 4-3) pool both periods, allow period-specific beta and gamma, include importer x period fixed effects, cluster SE at importing-country level. Compute Delta_beta = beta_s - beta_r with SE = sqrt(Var(beta_s)+Var(beta_r)-2*Cov(beta_s,beta_r)), t = Delta/SE, p-value. Under omega=0, Delta_eta = Delta_beta, so test for beta equals test for eta.
